purpose: Record the first native authored seven-letter route probe and the level-wide placement inventory before attempting exact completion timing.

authored_inventory.interpretation: Every used world contains the complete seven-type family; letters are authored records, not missing dispatch entries or synthetic-only declarations.

controls: KBD_right held for 600 frames before each post-baseline sample
KBD_space tapped with the right hold
read-only DS:60D8 capture added to each sample
native_route_probe.conclusion: The native rightward/jump sweep reached the authored letter objects and their shared 01F7:8D20 callbacks, but remained on lower platform positions and collected none. The completion gap is now a vertical/platform route problem, not an unknown letter initializer or callback.

next_probe.method: Use the authored W1L1 MAP/ARE placement inventory to drive a platform-aware route, sampling DS:60D8 and callback 01F7:8D20 after each letter overlap.
next_probe.why_not_more_rightward_sweeps: The player position wraps or is reset after obstacle/fall states, and repeated right+jump input never reaches the letters' 128-192 vertical bands.
next_probe.remaining_completion_gate: After a native 0x7F collection, trace the unforced DS:89E6 gate and the 01D7:5017/5038/5047 reload calls.
